facts.value: Electronics is a scientific and engineering discipline that studies and applies the principles of physics to design, create, and operate devices that manipulate electrons and other electrically charged particles.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: It is a subfield of physics and electrical engineering which uses active devices such as transistors, diodes, and integrated circuits to control and amplify the flow of electric current.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: Electronic devices have significantly influenced the development of many aspects of modern society, such as telecommunications, entertainment, education, health care, industry, and security.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: The main driving force behind the advancement of electronics is the semiconductor industry, which continually produces ever-more sophisticated electronic devices and circuits in response to global demand.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: The semiconductor industry is one of the global economy's largest and most profitable industries, with annual revenues exceeding $481 billion in 2018.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: Karl Ferdinand Braun's development of the crystal detector in 1874 inaugurated the field of electronics and the electron age.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: The identification of the electron in 1897 by Sir Joseph John Thomson paved the way for the development of modern electronic devices.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: Vacuum tubes were the first active electronic components which controlled current flow by influencing the flow of individual electrons.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: The invention of the integrated circuit solved problems of size and complexity in electronic circuits, leading to smaller and more efficient designs.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: An electronic component is any component, either active or passive, in an electronic system or electronic device.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: Electronic circuit functions can be divided into two function groups: analog and digital.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: Digital circuits are electric circuits based on discrete voltage levels and use Boolean algebra.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: Ternary logic has been studied, but not gained any significant practical acceptance in computers.
facts.programme_association: Electronic and Computer Engineering - BE or ME

facts.value: Highly integrated devices aim to satisfy specified requirements of the user.
